events.text:
Thanks, Hana. I checked your order, Q-7501 from Big Slice Pizza.

The courier's record shows the order was left at your door at 7:02 PM. It includes a photo of the bag at the door of apartment 1204. Because of that photo, I can't issue a refund or credit myself.

I've passed your case to a human specialist and marked it as a delivery dispute. They'll follow up with you within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide.

In the meantime, you could check with neighbors or the building's front desk or mailroom in case the bag was moved.

The order number is 7501, not Q-7501, but that's fine. A photo of a bag at my door? I never got anything. I'm telling you, there was nothing there when I checked at 7:10. Packages have gone missing in this building before, so the photo doesn't prove much to me. I want a full refund, and I don't want to wait a day for someone to tell me the same thing.

I understand why this is frustrating, Hana, especially if packages have gone missing in your building before. Your account of checking at 7:10 and finding nothing is in the case notes for the specialist.

I can't issue a refund myself, though. The courier's record has a photo of your order at your door, and our policy doesn't let me refund an order when the delivery is disputed against photo proof. I'm also not allowed to give a refund or credit as a goodwill gesture. The specialist is the only one who can review it, and they'll contact you within 24 hours. The escalation reference is ESC-700.

It would help the review if you add anything you have, such as a doorbell or door camera clip, or a note from building management about missing packages.

Is there anything else I can help with?

Pushing back once, as the persona would: I hear you, but "the specialist will decide" isn't really an answer for me. I'm not going to waste time digging for a doorbell clip for a pizza I never got. Can you at least tell me whether they can refund me before they review it, or is it all on hold until they decide?

Yes, it's on hold until the specialist reviews it. I can't refund you before that, and nothing will be issued to your account in the meantime. You also don't have to dig up a doorbell clip. It might help the review, but it isn't required.

I also can't tell you how the review will turn out, and I don't want to suggest a refund is coming when I don't know that. What I do know is that the case is open as ESC-700, your report is in it, and someone will follow up within 24 hours.

Fine. I don't like it, but I'd rather hear it from someone who can actually look at this than get a refund promise I can't count on. Put ESC-700 down for me and make sure they know I checked at 7:10 and nothing was there. If they don't reach me within 24 hours, I'm going to be back here.
